body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Enspert(www.Enspert.com) introduced 8.9-inch(1024x600) Tablet PC 'E501' with Honeycomb for the first time at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
